name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Plex connect codes from a Starlink/Funnel friend no longer fail just because Tailscale Funnel published DNS while HTTPS TLS is dead. Companion now prefers Plex Remote Access/Relay for the code even if a Funnel URL is saved, a Funnel URL can be cleared, and Jellyfin reports the TLS failure instead of a generic reachability error.
